name: Hong Kong Ferry (Holdings) Company Limited
summary: Hong Kong Ferry (Holdings) Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and investment businesses in Hong Kong. The company operates through five segments: Property Development; Property Investment; Ferry, Shipyard and Related Operations; Medical, Healthcare and Beauty Services; and Securities Investment. The company develops and sells residential units, commercial arcades, and car parking spaces; leases real estate properties; and offers property management services.
